object_hash_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), default separators, no trailing newline

preserved_hash_semantics.definition_sha256: Original frozen definition identity, which includes private audit metadata; not the hash of the projected public row.
preserved_hash_semantics.frozen_row_sha256: Original full row object under object_hash_encoding.
preserved_hash_semantics.frozen_spec_sha256: Original full execution spec, including machine-local bindings; portable resolved specs have a different identity.
preserved_hash_semantics.public_row_sha256: Exact portable row object under object_hash_encoding.
preserved_hash_semantics.stimulus_sha256: Recomputed from the five runtime fields, absent fields represented as null; unchanged.
